en: Colorized vintage view of an Italian-looking town square dominated by a tall rectangular stone clock tower with arched belfry openings at the top. Around the tower are multi‑story pastel buildings with shutters and arcades. In the foreground, several horse-drawn carts loaded with goods are parked in the open plaza, with low mountains visible in the distant background. The image is framed with a white border typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No legible caption or writing appears on the front.
